channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Estonia oo xiraysa dhammaan marinnada xuduudda Ruushka laga bilaabo 1 December
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Estonia, Margus Tsahkna, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in dalkiisu xiri doono dhammaan marinnada xuduudda Ruushka laga bilaabo 1 December, kadib isku day weerar dab-qabadsiin ah oo lala beegsaday shirkad difaac, kaas oo Tallinn ay ku eedeysay Moscow.

item.title: Kumanyaal qof oo Prague isugu soo baxay ka soo horjeedka qorshaha maalgelinta warbaahinta dadweynaha
item.description: Kumanyaal kun oo qof ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, isugu soo baxay beerta Letná ee Prague, caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda Czech, si ay uga soo horjeestaan qorshe dowladeed oo beddelaya habka loo maalgeliyo warbaahinta dadweynaha, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Hirshabeelle oo Korneel Cabdullaahi Barre Cilmi u magacaabay guddoomiyaha gobolka Hiiraan
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Hirshabeelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Guudlaawe), ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, Korneel Cabdullaahi Barre Cilmi u magacaabay guddoomiyaha cusub ee gobolka Hiiraan, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Ruto oo ugu baaqay Ntutu iyo Tongoyo inay xakameeyaan taageerayaashooda kadib qalalaasihii dabaaldegga Maa
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ugu baaqay Guddoomiyaha gobolka Narok Patrick Ole Ntutu iyo xildhibaanka Narok West Gabriel Tongoyo inay xakameeyaan taageerayaashooda, kadib qalalaase ka dhacay dabaaldegga Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Maa ee Sabtidii.

item.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo Sanca ku sii daayay 600 maxbuus oo la xiriira colaadda, sida ay sheegtay ICRC
item.description: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen ayaa magaalada Sanca ku sii daysay 600 qof oo loo xiray colaadda dalka, iyadoo la raacayo cafis ay keligeed ku dhawaaqday, sida ay sheegeen Guddiga Caalamiga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas (ICRC) iyo saraakiil Xuuti ah.

item.title: Mareykanka oo waayay heerka dal jadeecadu ka cirib-tirantay kadib sannad faafitaan ah
item.description: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Pan American (PAHO) ayaa ku dhawaaqday in Mareykanku waayay heerkiisa dal jadeecadu ka cirib-tirantay, kadib markii guddi khubaro ah ay go'aamiyeen in fayraska cudurkani uu dalka ku faafayay si aan kala go' lahayn in ka badan 12 bilood.

item.title: Iran oo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerartay saldhig Mareykan oo ku yaal Bahrain
item.description: Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay inay 6 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn ku beegsadeen xarun raadaar oo Mareykan ah oo ku taal saldhigga hawada ee Riffa ee Bahrain, halka Bahrain ay sheegtay in difaaceeda hawadu burburiyay weerarka.

item.title: Weerarro drone ah oo Ukraine qaaday oo ku dhacay Nizhnekamsk iyo Taganrog ee Ruushka
item.description: Saraakiisha Ruushka ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in weerarro drone ah oo Ukraine habeennimo qaaday ay waxyeelleeyeen xarumo warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Nizhnekamsk, halka weerar kale oo lagu qaaday Taganrog uu ku dhintay injineer ka shaqeynayay xarun koronto.

item.title: Xasan Sheekh oo dhagax-dhigay Jaamacadda Difaaca Qaranka, mucaaradkana ugu baaqay inay ku soo laabtaan wada-hadallada
item.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, dhagax-dhigay dhismaha Jaamacadda Difaaca Qaranka iyo dib-u-dhiska Isbitaalka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isagoo xilligaas ugu baaqay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka inay ku soo laabtaan miiska wada-hadallada.

item.title: Ruto oo ka jawaabay eedaha mucaaradka ee musuqmaasuqa tareenka SGR
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya, William Ruto, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku eedeeyay hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka inay si xulasho ah u soo xiganayaan warbixin Bangiga Adduunka oo walaac ka muujisay musuqmaasuq iyo daciifnimo ku jirtay iibsiga dhismaha tareenka SGR, isagoo sheegay in mashruuca la fuliyay xilligii dowlad hore, sida ay werisay Capital FM.

item.title: Hamas oo xaqiijisay dilka taliyaheeda Rafah, Samir Abu Younis, oo lagu dilay duqeyn Israa'iil
item.description: Garabka militari ee Hamas, Kataa'ib al-Qassam, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku dhawaaqay in taliyihii guutadeeda Rafah, Samir Abu Younis, lagu dilay duqeyn Israa'iil ay ka fulisay aagga al-Mawasi ee Khan Younis, koonfurta Gaza, sida ay werisay wakaaladda Anadolu oo Daily Sabah daabacday.

item.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamse: Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay awood ay iskaga difaacdo weerarrada internetka
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in Soomaaliya ay khasab ku tahay inay dhisato awood ay kaga hortagto weerarrada internetka iyo khataraha amniga dhijitaalka ah, xilli uu kormeer ku tagay xarunta Wasaaradda Isgaarsiinta iyo Tiknoolajiyadda ee Muqdisho.

item.title: Australia oo New Zealand 32-12 kaga adkaatay finalka Koobka Adduunka ee Rugby League
item.description: Australia ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku guuleysatay Koobka Adduunka ee Rugby League ee ragga markii afraad oo isku xigta, kadib markii ay finalkii ka dhacay garoonka Suncorp ee Brisbane 32-12 kaga adkaatay New Zealand, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Senator Ted Cruz oo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ugu baaqay inay aqoonsato Somaliland
item.description: Senator Ted Cruz oo ka tirsan Aqalka Senate-ka Mareykanka ayaa mar kale ku baaqay in Mareykanku si rasmi ah u aqoonsado Somaliland, isagoo qoraal uu soo dhigay barta X ku sheegay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibaddu ay qaaddo tallaabooyin waafaqsan aragtida Madaxweyne Donald Trump, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Cape Verde oo codeynaysa doorashada madaxweynaha, Neves oo la tartamaya musharraxa ugu horreysa ee haweenka
item.description: Codbixiyeyaasha Cape Verde ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, u codeynaya doorashada madaxweynaha, halkaas oo Madaxweyne José Maria Neves uu xilka mar labaad u raadinayo, kuna tartamayo Joana Rosa, oo ah haweenayda ugu horreysa ee dalkaas u tartanta xilka madaxweynaha, sida ay werisay Euronews.

item.title: Nigeria oo muwaadiniinteeda uga digtay inay maraan garoonka Bole ee Addis Ababa sababo caafimaad dartood
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Nigeria ayaa muwaadiniinteeda, gaar ahaan kuwa qaba xanuunno, uga digtay inay safar ku maraan garoonka Bole ee Addis Ababa joogga sare ee magaalada dartiis, kadib markii 16 Nigerian ay sanadkan dhinteen iyagoo sii maraya, sida ay werisay KBC.

item.title: Yemen: ciidamada koonfureed oo ka baxay Bab el-Mandeb iyo garoonka Dhubab, Xuuthiyiintu waa la wareegeen
item.description: Ciidamada Hubaysan ee Koonfurta Yemen ayaa ka baxay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Dhubab iyo deegaanka Bab el-Mandeb ee galbeedka gobolka Taiz, taasoo goobtaas u daysay xoogagga Xuuthiyiinta, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Urdun: saddex nin oo dil lagu xukumay weerarkii kaniisadda Karak ee 9 qof lagu dilay
item.description: Maxkamadda Amniga Dowladda ee Urdun ayaa saddex nin ku xukuntay dil daldalaad ah, kadib markii lagu helay inay fuliyeen weerarkii hubaysnaa ee 23 October lagu qaaday kaniisad ku taal koonfurta dalka, sida ay sheegeen ciidamada Urdun.

item.title: Axmed Madoobe oo u ambabaxaya Garoowe si uu Deni ula falanqeeyo muranka doorashooyinka
item.description: Madaxweynaha Jubaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe), ayaa la filayaa inuu maalmaha soo socda booqasho ku tago Garoowe, si uu Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ugala hadlo khilaafka hannaanka doorashooyinka Soomaaliya, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo ka mid noqotay 133 dal oo taageeray qaraarka QM ee hakinta xukunka dilka
item.description: Soomaaliya ayaa codkeeda siisay qaraar uu Guddiga Saddexaad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ansixiyay 13 November 2026, kaas oo dalalka ugu baaqaya inay hakiyaan fulinta xukunka dilka, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Mooyaale: in ka badan 10,000 oo qof oo ku barakacay gudaha Kenya, cudurro ayaa laga cabsi qabaa
item.description: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Marsabit ee Kenya ayaa sheegay in in ka badan 10,000 oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha Kenya kadib colaadaha ka socda deegaanka Mooyaale ee xuduudda Itoobiya, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.

item.title: UFC 334: Ciryl Gane oo Josh Hokit ku garaacay go'aan dhammaystiran, kuna haystay koobka miisaanka culus
item.description: Faransiiska Ciryl Gane ayaa difaacay horyaalnimada miisaanka culus ee UFC, kadib markii uu Josh Hokit kaga adkaaday go'aan garsoorayaal oo dhammaystiran (48-47, 48-47, 48-47) ciyaartii ugu weyneyd ee UFC 334 ee Madison Square Garden, New York.

item.title: Australia iyo Filibiin oo Manila ku saxiixday heshiis difaac oo cusub
item.description: Australia iyo Filibiin ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, magaalada Manila ku saxiixay heshiis cusub oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga ciidamada, iyadoo Filibiin ay khilaaf ba'an kala dhexeeyo Shiinaha Badda Koonfurta Shiinaha.

item.title: Iran: saddex markab oo saliid ah oo miino ku dhacay Hormuz, Bahrain oo dhawaaq digniin ah shiday
item.description: Ciidamada badda ee IRGC ayaa sheegay in laba markab oo saliid sida ay qarxeen oo dab qabsadeen kadib markii ay miino ku dhaceen koonfurta Marinka Hormuz, halka Axaddii, 15 November, dhawaaqyada digniinta ay ka dhawaaqeen Bahrain.

item.title: UFC 334: Kayla Harrison oo Amanda Nunes ku ceejisay wareegga afraad, kuna haysatay koobka
item.description: Kayla Harrison ayaa difaacatay horyaalnimada miisaanka bantamweight ee UFC kadib markii ay wareegga afraad ceejis kaga adkaatay Amanda Nunes, Sabtidii habeennimo garoonka Madison Square Garden ee New York.

item.title: Sacuudiga oo sheegay inuu riday laba gantaal oo Xuuthiyiintu ku ganeen Riyadh
item.description: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay in difaaca cirku uu Axaddii, 15 November, riday laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo Xuuthiyiinta Yemen ay ku ganeen caasimadda Riyadh, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Bilibili Gaming oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Gen.G, kuna guuleysatay koobka adduunka ee League of Legends
item.description: Kooxda Shiinaha ee Bilibili Gaming (BLG) ayaa 3-1 kaga adkaatay kooxda Kuuriyada Koonfureed ee Gen.G finalka koobka adduunka ee ciyaarta elektaroonigga ah ee League of Legends, oo ka dhacay Barclays Center ee New York, waxayna jebisay 4 sano oo ay Kuuriyada Koonfureed ku guuleysanaysay.

item.title: SpaceX oo markii ugu horreysay gacmaha munaaradda ku qabatay Starship ka soo laabtay hawada sare
item.description: Shirkadda SpaceX ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, markii ugu horreysay taariikhda ku qabatay markabka hawada sare ee Starship gacmaha waaweyn ee munaaradda ganitaanka ee Starbase, Texas, kadib markii uu ka soo laabtay safar uu ku wareegay dhulka, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Netanyahu oo ugu baaqay dowlad midnimo, Eisenkot oo ku tilmaamay khiyaamo
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaaraha xilka u sii hayaa ee Israa'iil, Benjamin Netanyahu, ayaa Sabtidii, 14 November, mar kale ugu baaqay in isaga iyo Gadi Eisenkot ay dhisaan dowlad midnimo qaran, halka Eisenkot uu baaqaas ku tilmaamay khiyaamo.

item.title: Mirra Andreeva oo Pegula ka badisay, gaartayna finalka WTA Finals
item.description: Ciyaartoyda Ruushka ah ee Mirra Andreeva ayaa 6-3, 6-4 kaga adkaatay Jessica Pegula semi-finalka WTA Finals ee Indian Wells, waxayna noqotay ciyaartoydii ugu da'da yarayd ee gaarta finalka tartankan muddo 22 sano ah.
